meta.notes: Official tfl.gov.uk fares pages returned 404 to fetcher; most fares come from secondary sources quoting the March 2026 TfL fare decision. Verify before shipping.

single_current.conditions: Frozen at least until July 2026; one source (London Assembly schedule dated 2 Jul 2026, via search summary) says rises to 1.85 from 1 Nov 2026 - unverified, conflicting

daily_cap.conditions: New cap after Nov rise not found

hopper.conditions: Unlimited bus/tram journeys within 1 hour of first touch-in, for the price of one fare (same caveat on Nov rise)

weekly_zones_1_2.conditions: 7-day, any start day, frozen Mar 2026-Mar 2027; equals weekly PAYG cap

monthly_zones_1_2.conditions: Not found in sources; do not hardcode

travelcards.student_oyster_discount_on_travelcards: 30% off adult Travelcards and Bus&Tram passes (so ~31.29 per week Z1-2 if base 44.70; derived)

discount.conditions: 30% off adult Travelcards and Bus & Tram season passes only. PAYG fares NOT discounted.

eligibility.summary: 18+, live in a London borough during term time, enrolled at a school/college/university registered on the TfL scheme (or mandatory London placement 14+ weeks). Institution outside Greater London may qualify if student lives in London and travels regularly. Full-time (15+ structured hours/week, 14+ weeks) or listed exceptions. Needs a TfL-registered institution; not a London institution strictly. Card expires when course ends.

railcard_on_oyster.summary: 16-25 or 26-30 Railcard can be added to a registered Oyster for 1/3 off off-peak PAYG fares and (per TfL student page) daily caps; set at a station/Oyster ticket shop. Combinable with 18+ Student Oyster.

contactless_vs_oyster.summary: Same PAYG fares and caps. Oyster needed for photocard/Travelcard discounts and Railcard loading; contactless needs the same card/device for each tap to cap correctly; contactless works on all modes with no top-up; Oyster has refundable £7 deposit style card cost (unverified).

one_year.conditions: 1/3 off most rail fares; mature students 26+ eligible (full-time, 15h/wk). Not valid on season tickets/Travelcards. GBP12 min fare Mon-Fri before ~10am (not Jul/Aug, weekends, Advance)

three_year.conditions: Buy up to day before 24th birthday

one_year.conditions: 1/3 off; online only; no season tickets; price rose from 30 in Mar 2025

bank_perk.summary: No Santander/HSBC student-account railcard perk found (searched); not confirmed to exist. Do not claim.

first_30min_pedal.conditions: Per ride, pedal bike; extra 30 min 1.65

annual.conditions: Unlimited 60-min rides; Cycling UK members 25% off; no dedicated student deal found

per_minute.conditions: E-bike, London, plus ~1.00 unlock; Greenmoov says 0.29; rates vary by borough/time; passes exist via Lime subscription
Aggregator figure, undated, plus ~1 unlock; operating status in 2026 London borough trials not confirmed
Aggregator figure, undated; Voi Hackney ebike cap 1.75/30 min; Voi was operating in Hackney

national_express_ypc.conditions: Per year (or 30 for 3 yrs per Save the Student); 1/3 off standard/flexible fares; ages 16-26 or full-time students; not on Restricted fares; 10 promo + 2.50 post seen on renewal

megabus.conditions: No student card; YPC not valid; 10% off with TOTUM; fares vary, GBP1 booking fee on promo fares

tfl_unified_api.free: Public TfL open data under transport data terms; free key via portal (no pricing shown)
tfl_unified_api.registration: Optional but recommended; register at api-portal.tfl.gov.uk, subscribe to plan in Products, use app_key query param (app_id no longer needed)
tfl_unified_api.rate_limits: Portal mentions a '500 requests' data plan; third parties conflict (500/min with key vs ~500/day anonymous). Unverified.
offers: Fares (/Stopstop/.. Fares via Journey/StopPoint fares endpoints)

suggested_default_daily_budget_zone_1_2.basis: Weekly Z1-2 student Travelcard ~31.29 (44.70 x 0.70) / 7 = 4.47 if student photocard; PAYG: ~8.90 cap on heavy days. Default 6.40/day = ~44.70/week (PAYG weekly cap) as safe ceiling; lower option 4.50/day with 18+ Student Oyster Travelcard (derived, verify).
